dt: Deadlines Apr 20 and Oct 20 each year; the Oct 20, 2026 round has closed, next deadline Apr 20, 2027
e: For PhD students enrolled at a university (preferably, but not necessarily, in an ESO member state) to spend one to two years at ESO in Garching or Santiago; ESO Santiago also offers up to two places a year for students at Chilean universities. Projects are mostly optical/IR/ALMA, so a weak fit for pulsar timing.
